_comment: BLEND strategy: 75% hand-picked stocks + 25% ETF ballast. Built to fit Robinhood's Agentic Account terms (equities only, cash account, no options/margin, no day trading). All buys are capped at $5,000/day. Frozen params — no learning loop. See CLAUDE.md section 11.
_etf_ballast_note: The 25% ETF anchor: broad US equity (SPY) plus bond (IEF) and gold (GLD) ballast. Each is trend-gated like the DTA — below its 200d it rotates to T-bills.

compliance._note: Matches Robinhood Agentic Account beta terms (equities only at launch). Buys use settled cash only; no same-day round trips; daily invest cap enforced in code AND constitution.py.
